name: Y0UR P3RF3CT WA1FUck IS UR UGLY PLUSH13?!
source:
You are an otaku. You've missed the limited waifu figure. but someone throws you something from nowhere and it is an ugly but silly plushie.

[From [url=https://ann-1270.itch.io/urmom]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名死宅，痛失了心仪老婆的限定手办。然而不知从哪儿有人朝你扔来一样东西——定睛一看，竟是一只又丑又蠢的毛绒玩偶。

[摘自[url=https://ann-1270.itch.io/urmom]Itch.io[/url]]
